text: MOFCOM released its 2025 assessment of China’s national economic and technological development zones. In 2024 the zones generated 15.4 tln yuan of GDP, equivalent to 11.4% of national GDP. Zone tax revenues accounted for 25.8% of their host prefectural-level cities’ tax receipts,
text_zh: 商务部发布2025年国家级经济技术开发区考核结果，2024年经开区实现GDP15.4万亿元，占全国GDP的11.4%；经开区税收收入占所在设区市税收收入的25.8%。
